CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select auth.uid();
$function$
functions.name: current_user_id

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, display_name)
  values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', new.email))
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$
functions.name: handle_new_user

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.invite_token_hash(p_token text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select extensions.digest(convert_to(p_token, 'utf8'), 'sha256'::text);
$function$
functions.name: invite_token_hash

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_agency_admin(p_agency_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    public.is_super_user()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.agency_memberships m
      where m.agency_id = p_agency_id
        and m.user_id = auth.uid()
        and m.role = 'admin'
    );
$function$
functions.name: is_agency_admin

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_agency_member(p_agency_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.agency_memberships m
    where m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.agency_id = p_agency_id
  );
$function$
functions.name: is_agency_member

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_user()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((
    select p.is_super_user
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid()
  ), false);
$function$
functions.name: is_super_user

views.definition:
SELECT id,
    agency_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    summary,
    notes,
    due_at,
    completed_at,
    created_at,
    assigned_to,
    metadata,
    escalated_at,
    escalation_level,
    escalation_workflow_event_id,
        CASE
            WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN false
            WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN false
            WHEN due_at < date_trunc('day'::text, now()) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_overdue,
        CASE
            WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN false
            WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN false
            WHEN due_at >= date_trunc('day'::text, now()) AND due_at < (date_trunc('day'::text, now()) + '1 day'::interval) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_due_today,
        CASE
            WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN false
            WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN false
            WHEN due_at >= (date_trunc('day'::text, now()) + '1 day'::interval) AND due_at < (date_trunc('day'::text, now()) + '4 days'::interval) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_due_soon,
        CASE
            WHEN escalation_level = 'overdue_7_days'::text THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_escalated,
        CASE
            WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE GREATEST(0, floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - due_at) / 86400::numeric)::integer)
        END AS overdue_days
   FROM activity_log t
  WHERE activity_type = 'task'::text;
views.name: task_status_view
